fusions.name: Scrape the Platter
fusions.desc: A carving strike that deals 16 damage, uses up every affliction you have on the target and deals 60% more damage for each one, then leaves it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. You heal for 25% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Soup to Nuts
fusions.desc: Lashes out around you, dealing 7 blood damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, and heals you for 15% of the damage dealt. Its effect rises 8% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies. Holds 3 charges, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Groaning Board
fusions.desc: Restores 16 health to you and every ally within 4 tiles, 1% more for each 1% of cast speed you have. Its healing rises 10% for each ally near you, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Second Helping
fusions.desc: Each time you gain health, you regain 3 more health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
